parameters.text:
=You parse stakeholder emails into Kanban ticket fields for Join-Issue Collector.

Two email styles are common:
1) Create Request template with labels Description: / Subtask: / Enddate:
2) Free-form email with optional Subtasks list and a deadline line like 'bis 27.7.26'.

Rules:
- title: short summary, max 80 chars
- description: request text without subtasks, deadlines, greeting/signature
- subtasks: only explicit Subtask/Subtasks list items; else []
- dueDate: YYYY-MM-DD or empty string
- category: "User Story" or "Technical Task"
- priority: "HighPriority", "MidPriority", or "LowPriority"
- creatorName: person name from signature/display name; never an email
- Ignore signatures and footers.

Email from: {{ $json.from }}
Subject: {{ $json.subject }}
Body:
{{ $json.body }}

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "title": "Dark Mode testen",
  "description": "Bitte Dark Mode bis Ende August testen.",
  "category": "User Story",
  "priority": "MidPriority",
  "dueDate": "2026-08-31",
  "subtasks": [
    "Kontrast pruefen",
    "Mobile Ansicht testen"
  ],
  "creatorName": "Max Mustermann"
}

assignments.name: creatorName
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const ai = String($json.output?.creatorName || '').trim(); const fallback = String($('Prepare email context1').item.json.creatorName || '').trim(); const name = ai || fallback; return (!name || name.includes('@') || /^(stakeholder|unknown|guest)$/i.test(name)) ? '' : name; })() }}

assignments.name: subtasks
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const raw = $json.output?.subtasks; if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return []; const seen = new Set(); const out = []; for (const entry of raw) { let value = typeof entry === 'string' ? entry : (entry?.value || ''); value = String(value).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); if (value.length < 3) continue; const key = value.toLowerCase(); if (seen.has(key)) continue; seen.add(key); out.push({ value, checked: false }); } return out; })() }}
